title: The boy's lunch pail
logline: A lunch pail on the fence post outside the mill, 1994, a boy's, left there while he watches through the wire. Which boy: the page won't say; the pail has no name on it. The pail from the lunchroom page, before it was scratched.

panels.composition: A dented lunch pail sitting on top of a chain-link fence post outside a mill yard, the yard beyond with its stack, no one, black spotting in the dents.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a dented lunch pail sitting on top of a chain-link fence post outside a mill yard with a smoking stack beyond, no people, no words
image.notes: The pail from ro_2023-01-29 before its name was scratched. Reserved.
